name: phoenixai
description: A secure multi-model desktop workspace led by Grok Build.
author: PhoenixAI contributors

scripts.package:folder: npm.cmd run provision:local-credentials && npm.cmd run clean:release && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/package-desktop.ps1 && npm.cmd run clean:release
scripts.dist:win: npm.cmd run provision:local-credentials && npm.cmd run clean:release && npm.cmd run icon && npm.cmd run verify && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-windows.ps1 -Publish never && npm.cmd run verify:installer && npm.cmd run clean:release
scripts.release: node scripts/verify-release.mjs && npm.cmd run clean:release && npm.cmd run icon && npm.cmd run verify && node scripts/tag-release.mjs && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-windows.ps1 -Publish always && node scripts/verify-packaged.mjs --installer --require-signed && npm.cmd run clean:release
scripts.release:dry: npm.cmd run provision:local-credentials && npm.cmd run clean:release && npm.cmd run icon && npm.cmd run verify && powershell.exe -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/build-windows.ps1 -Publish never && npm.cmd run verify:installer && npm.cmd run clean:release
